metadata.description: Semantic relationship map for the approved EduQuery AI NLP training scope. Documents implicit relationships, join paths, and column synonyms without excluded, credential-bearing, or authentication tables.

relationships.name: Student-to-PracticalMarks

relationships.name: Student-to-ResultLogs

relationships.name: Student-to-QuizAnswers

relationships.name: Teacher-to-CombinedMarks

relationships.name: Teacher-to-HallOfFame

relationships.name: Teacher-to-ResultSummary

SCHOOL.description: Campus code (e.g., ATKB, MNWB). Present on nearly every table. Primary multi-campus filter.

YEAR.description: Academic year in 2-digit format (22=2022, 23=2023, etc.). Present on nearly every table. Primary temporal filter.

CLASS.description: Class/grade level (1-12). Present on most tables.

SECTION.description: Section within a class (A, B, C). Present on most tables.
